title: ShowNet TLS golden fingerprint entry
description: One captured ClientHello fingerprint for a (presetId, platform) pair. Used as the hard gate for outbound TLS alignment claims. See src-tauri/testdata/tls-golden/README.md and docs/plan-real-browser-ja3-impersonate.md section 4.

presetId.description: Catalog preset id this golden gates, e.g. chrome150, chrome-android150, safari-ios18.

platform.description: A presetId on a different platform is a DIFFERENT golden. Never reuse a desktop capture to gate an android or ios preset.

family.description: Client family. Drives which connector/stack is legitimate.

major.description: Client major version the capture represents.

stack.description: TLS stack actually used by the client. iOS Safari and Chrome iOS are apple-network, NOT chromium-boringssl. Do not guess: mark unknown until confirmed.

stackVersion.description: Free-form stack revision: Chromium full version, tree boringssl revision, iOS/CFNetwork version. Null when not determined.

status.description: pending-capture: placeholder, all golden fields MUST be null and the gate treats it as absent. captured: usable by the gate. superseded: target moved on, gate must fall back to recipe.

alignment.description: Highest alignment this entry may authorise. Derived from source: tool-capture -> tool-matched, browser-capture -> browser-matched. A pending-capture entry is always recipe.

kind.description: browser-capture is the acceptance basis. tool-capture (curl-impersonate et al) may only authorise tool-matched. pending means not yet collected.

tool.description: Required when kind is tool-capture, e.g. curl-impersonate 0.9.x chrome150 profile.

environment.description: Capture environment: exact client build, OS version, architecture, device.

capturedAt.description: ISO date of capture. Null only while pending.

golden.description: All fields MUST be null while status is pending-capture. Never populate these from documentation, blog posts, or the catalog documentedJa3 value.

ja3.description: MD5 of the JA3 canonical string.

ja3Raw.description: JA3 canonical string, retained so the hash can be recomputed after an algorithm change.

ja4.description: JA4 fingerprint. Soft gate: may lag behind ja3.

clientHelloHex.description: Raw ClientHello record bytes, lowercase hex. The authoritative artefact: ja3/ja4 above are derived and can be recomputed from this.

notes.description: GREASE behaviour, ECH presence, post-quantum groups, ALPS, or any caveat a reviewer needs.
